BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: IMSC   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: FT   SESSION: SP/2020

SUBJECT: IMF6005 AGRICULTURAL AND RURAL ECONOMICS

TIME: 1.5 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
6. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) Point out the three dimensions of rural development. [2]
 (b) Enumerate the features of rural development.

[3]

Q2 (a) Enlist the objectives of rural development. [2]
 (b) Describe the problems of rural development. [3]


Q3 (a) Define rural unemployment. [2]
 (b) Describe the policies for reducing the rural poverty. [3]


Q4 (a) Distinguish between open and concealed unemployment. [2]
 (b) Describe the causes of rural unemployment.

[3]
Q5 (a) Write short note on collectivization of resources of rural development strategy. [2]
 (b) Enumerate the consequences of rural unemployment. [3]


Q6 (a) How rural poverty was created? [2]
 (b) Explain the remedial measures for reducing rural unemployment.

[3]

CLASS: IMSC   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: FOOD TECHNOLOGY  SESSION : SP/2019

SUBJECT : IMF6005 AGRICULTURAL AND RURAL ECONOMICS

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Write about Three distinct strategies for rural development. [2]
 (b) Describe the Area Development Strategy and give the names of programmes associated
with this strategy.
[3]

Q2 (a) What are the multiple objectives of rural development? [2]
 (b) What do you mean by small, marginal and large farmers, explain with examples? [3]

Q3 (a) What types of multiple approaches are needed to improve rural poverty? [2]
 (b) Write a note on “Agriculture is only one aspect of rural development”. [3]

Q4 (a) What are the Scope/Importance of Agricultural Extension? [2]
 (b) Distinguish between agricultural extension and rural extension. [3]

Q5 (a) Define agricultural labour. Categorize agricultural labour. [2]
 (b) Mention the government measures to improve the conditions of agricultural labour. [3]

Q6 (a) How we can increase the efficiency of agricultural labour? [2]
 (b) Describe the causes for the growth of Agricultural Labour. [3]
